paras: Lepidophyma lipetzi, also known commonly as Lipetz's tropical night lizard and la lagartija nocturna del Ocote in Mexican Spanish, is a species of lizard in the family Xantusiidae. It is a small lizard which is native to Mexico.
The specific name, lipetzi, is in honor of American biochemist Milton L. Lipetz.
L. lipetzi is endemic to the Mexican state of Chiapas.
The preferred natural habitat of L. lipetzi is forest, at altitudes around 600 m (2,000 ft).
